p: us return unto the LORD: He shows the people that they ought to turn to the Lord, so that he might stop his plagues.
he revive us: Though he correct us from time to time, yet his help will not be far off, if we return to him.
your goodness is as a morning: You seem to have a certain holiness and repentance, but it is very sudden, and as a morning cloud.

hewed them by the prophets: I have still laboured by my prophets, and as it were prepared you to bring you to correction, but all was in vain: for my word was not food to feed them, but a sword to slay them.
judgments are as the light that: My doctrine which I taught you, was most evident.
mercy: He shows to what his doctrine was aimed at, that they should unite the obedience of God, and the love of their neighbour, with outward sacrifices.
like men have transgressed the covenant: That is, like small and weak persons.
Gilead is a city of them: Which was the place where the priests dwelt, and which should have been best instructed in my word.
harvest for thee: That is, imitates your idolatry, and has taken grafts of your trees.
